text: Intensional MLTT differs from extensional MLTT primarily in that:
choices: Extensional MLTT has decidable type-checking; intensional does not
Intensional MLTT has decidable type-checking; extensional makes equality reflection a rule which breaks decidability
explanation: Extensional MLTT has the equality reflection rule (propositional → definitional equality), which makes type-checking undecidable. Intensional MLTT avoids this.
